C.checked_pairs: all 225 robot self pairs at every setup, action, hold and return interval

backend_name_mapping.mujoco_geometry_suffix_rule: The construction screen uses the same names with _collision suffix; final FCL tables use the FCL body names above.

H.checked_non_intentional_pairs: all 225 robot self pairs plus paperboard against every robot collision body not excluded by the exact current phase

phase_rules.boundary: Ends immediately before the prospectively named RECEIVER_SEATING transition. Paperboard-right_hand remains checked throughout free approach.
phase_rules.intended_payload_contacts: paperboard against the four left gripper internal bodies only
paperboard against the four left and four right gripper internal bodies
phase_rules.reason: The paperboard is prospectively seated inside the receiver and held by both grippers; the previously observed paperboard-right_hand zero is treated as this named terminal task contact, not a broad approach exclusion.

phase_rules.boundary: Ends at the first prospectively logged sender-clear state after the left gripper has opened; subsequent left payload pairs are checked.
phase_rules.intended_payload_contacts: paperboard against the four right gripper bodies and transiently the four left gripper bodies
paperboard against the four right gripper internal bodies only

R.checked_pairs: all 225 robot self pairs plus each of the 23 robot collision bodies against the foam in every R phase
R.world_contact_rule: Only foam-to-qualified-support contact while BASE_SEATED is an intended world contact. It excludes no robot-to-foam pair.

current_model_identity.final_freeze_rule: Live runtime canonical XML, resolved meshes and collision object names must match the final zero-send package. These current paths are design identities, not a waiver of the final live identity check.

global_rule: Every collision pair is unordered. All 225 non-SRDF-allowed robot self pairs remain active in every H/R/C phase. A task contact is excluded only for the named payload/resource pair and named phase below; no observed result may create a new exclusion after C-01 starts.
live_reproduction_rule: The final zero-send must reproduce the 225 self-pair universe, exact H phase exclusions and R world identity against the live-matched runtime. Mismatch blocks action-client creation.
review_projection_note: Historical pre-start status fields are retained as campaign metadata; final outcomes are recorded under results/final-revalidation/c115/.

robot_self_universe.semantic_reuse: The same robot and SRDF pair universe is used by all three families; final package generation must reproduce the exact 225 rows from the final runtime identity.
